_comment: Benchmark WODs. 'min_phase' locks a benchmark until that phase (high-volume classics are Phase 3). Benchmarks are never auto-programmed into a normal day; they are an explicit, opt-in test. When one is offered, the engine still runs it through apply_safety_caps, so the reps you are prescribed never exceed your current per-session cap — the 'rx' reps are shown as reference only, with a warning when they exceed your cap. 'movements' lists the structured work so volume can be checked.

benchmarks.name: Cindy
benchmarks.stimulus: Steady gymnastics engine; keep rounds unbroken and smooth.

benchmarks.name: Karen
benchmarks.stimulus: 150 wall balls for time — very high eccentric volume. Scaled hard for a returning athlete.

benchmarks.name: Fran
benchmarks.stimulus: 21-15-9 thrusters + pull-ups. Classic sprint; scale load and reps.

benchmarks.name: Murph
benchmarks.stimulus: 1mi run, 100 pull-ups, 200 push-ups, 300 squats, 1mi run. Partition and scale heavily.

benchmarks.name: Bike Baseline Test
benchmarks.stimulus: Repeatable conditioning test: max calories in a fixed time, or time for a fixed distance.
